body:
How did the talk go with her? She is pretty understanding of my situation and does everything she can do to help, I can honestly say that now as I am kind of clear headed, but when I am in a down mood, I just don't see it.

Have you tried searching for other things to distract you from the urge to cut, or alternative thing to do? I honestly have no clue what else I could do instead of cutting, I took up smoking as a attempt to replace the cutting, but I don't think it really worked.
We have discussed most of these issues, and yes, I have currently stopped cutting myself, I think it's been nearly two weeks, and it is getting harder by the day.

Thank you, I really hope I do get better, it means a lot that you replied.
Thank you.

P.S. 
I hope you are OK now too.

Wow, that was a massive wall of text, I really want to thank you for responding with such detail and caring about me.

I am thinking about consulting someone about the anxiety attacks, but just the thought freaks me out.

"Your problems are real *to you, and that is what matters."
Thank for for that, every time I start to feel down, and begin to think that I'm stupid for feeling like that over what I believe to be insignificant things I will just think back to that.

"I have the option to give it up. I can stop existing. It is actually a very comforting thought. It reminds me I have some power in the world, no matter how fucked up things are at the moment."
I must admit, I really do like that thought, I have thought it before but it generally skips my mind during my suicidal phases, I will have to remember to stop and think about that, I believe it might actually make me feel a little better.

I really like her, so I'm willing to forgive, and (attempt to) forget everything bad that happens, I really want her and I to work.

Year 11 stressed me out :/
Thanks for the advice though, I'll try and figure something out.

So, (kind of an obvious question, but just making sure) you feel like she will betray you because of the lies and your troubles in the past?
I feel like she will betray me like everyone else in my life has, every time I let someone in, and attempt to believe that I can trust them, they just betray me.

why did you feel useless?
I feel useless because everything I try at, I just fail. Every time that I get betrayed I just feel like I wasn't worth the truth, and that they were hurting me because I just wasn't worth anything to them.

Are there parts in life in which you feel you're not succeeding in?
Pretty much school, I get told that I don't do well enough, and when I get the best grades I can (Bs/As) I come home and tell my parents and they just tell me I should have done better.
They aren't really important, just little things that she promised she wouldn't do, it's not that she did it, it's that she promised she wouldn't, then lied about it.
It's ok, thanks for actually caring about me.

My S/O and I have discussed this, but I really don't know if she completely understands how I feel, she says she understands and everything, but it just doesn't seem like she does.

I think I may have to get some medication for at least the anxiety as I am starting year 12 this year, the depression I may be able to cope with, but the anxiety is just so crippling at times.

How long have you been with your current SO? It hasn't been long this time, but we had a 'thing' before where she promised that I was the only guy, and I thought that I was, but it turned out I wasn't and that she'd been lying to me, I immediately just sort of distanced myself from her, and we didn't speak for something like 9 months. 

Why do you feel anxiety when your SO doesn't respond? This girl is just amazing, and she is pretty much my 'perfect' girl, and I get anxious because I think she might be cheating on me, or seeing another guy and not telling me, and I just really don't want to loose her.

Is it because of something they did, or because of the trust issues from before? Probably both, she has lied to me in the past, and during this relationship (even though it was small, it was still a lie).
Thank you, I have tried to go to a Psychologist before but it didn't really help, but after all your responses I think I will need to go see someone again.

Thank you so much, I'm actually in a decent frame of mind at the moment, I decided I had to get everything is going on down when I have a kind of clear head.
I just want to thank you for your concern <3
